reuse.why: Every link handler, including the new Fintegra one, goes through one guard and reuses findOrCreateBank/handleSyncResponse/db.updateAccount, but the Fintegra link and download functions are copies rather than shared code.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount duplicates the ~80-line upgrade-or-insert/sync/notify body of the other providers and downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates the Akahu/Pluggy download function; the guard call itself is repeated per provider.

placement.why: Provider code lands in the right modules, but the closed-account rule and the detach-previous-holder mutation are packed into a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked rather than separate linking steps.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (duplicate refusal, Fintegra, replace-existing-link, closed accounts) plus tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralising the link preconditions is good, but the 'assert' helper now validates two unrelated rules and silently mutates other accounts behind a boolean flag, and the per-provider link body remains a sixfold copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all six link handlers call assertBankAccountNotLinked before linking

disguised_duplication.where: the Fintegra link and download functions are plain copies of existing provider functions, not reshaped

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts gains a replaceExistingLink flag, a closed-target check and a loop that detaches previous holders
